title: Transcriptome analysis and molecular docking reveal the activation of FOXO4, TNFSF15 and CASP9 in HeLa cells treated with DCM fraction from Clinacanthus nutans (C. nutans).
authors: Pey Adum, Kristine Sandra; Haron, Nor Hasyimah; Md Toha, Zaleha; Arsad, Hasni
journal: Journal of Asian natural products research
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过转录组分析和分子对接探讨植物提取物对HeLa细胞中FOXO4等基因的激活，但仅涉及蛋白-小分子对接，未聚焦蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Clinacanthus nutans (C. nutans) is a well-known herb in tropical Asia. Previous studies have reported the anticancer activity of C. nutans but the molecular mechanisms on cervical cancer are not fully understood. Therefore, our study aims to explore its effects on HeLa line and analyse the molecular interactions. Firstly, the RNA-Seq reads were processed for differentially expressed analyses. With Ingenuity Pathway Analysis (IPA) method, five cell death-related pathways with three significant genes (CASP9, FOXO4, TNFSF15) were identified. This study provides insight into the potential role of the DCM fraction of C. nutans mediating cell death mechanism in cervical cancer.
abstract_zh: Clinacanthus nutans（C. nutans）是热带亚洲的一种知名草药。已有研究报告了C. nutans的抗癌活性，但其对宫颈癌的分子机制尚未完全明了。因此，本研究旨在探讨其对HeLa细胞系的影响，并分析分子相互作用。首先，对RNA-Seq读数进行处理以进行差异表达分析。通过Ingenuity Pathway Analysis（IPA）方法，鉴定出五个与细胞死亡相关的通路及三个显著基因（CASP9、FOXO4、TNFSF15）。本研究为C. nutans的DCM组分在宫颈癌中介导细胞死亡机制的潜在作用提供了见解。
